security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU's HLV/HSV/HLVX emulation does not inspect VS-stage page table MTAG and execute bits to decide tag-check applicability, and does not populate hstatus.MTAG_I/mstatus.MTAG_I on trap entry with the code-page MTAG bit. Specifically: (1) HLV/HSV always generate checked or unchecked accesses without considering VS-stage PTE.X or hstatus.MTAG_I opt-out; (2) HLVX does not collect the VS-stage leaf PTE MTAG bit into hstatus.MTAG_I; (3) on trap to HS/M-mode with nonzero htinst/mtval, the MTAG bit from the trapping instruction's code page is not deposited into hstatus.MTAG_I/mstatus.MTAG_I; (4) MPRV=1 with MXR=1 does not collect first-stage PTE MTAG into mstatus.MTAG_I and does not suppress tag checks when the effective-mode leaf PTE has X set or mstatus.MTAG_I is set.
security_spec.summary: Failure to implement MTAG opt-out logic for HLV/HSV/HLVX and MPRV paths causes QEMU to either spuriously inject tag-check faults during hypervisor guest-memory emulation (breaking nested virtualization) or silently skip required tag checks, creating a privilege-domain violation where the hypervisor observes memory access behavior inconsistent with the guest's configured page-table MTAG policy.
